title: Sancerre Cry 4
text: Hmm You was a church for me You was a word for me You crammed behind the fold, my mighty horse Hey You took me out of fame You took me out of life Say you ride with every handful Hey, don't say it in your soul Your wear is fine and all Your wear's the market sign of light and light Hey Light and light, light and light Light and light, light and light Hmm.
